description: Defense-in-depth command policy. Unreal generation, cooking, packaging, and similar high-privilege commands are never treated as generally safe. They require explicit per-handoff permission, assigned generated output ownership, and will be audited. Discovered commands only; no invention of paths or wrappers.

blocked_patterns.reason: No remote mutations or PRs from any agent. Orchestrator coordinates branches locally only.
Pipe-to-shell or remote code execution vector.

read_only: Basic repository reads, git status/log/diff (within worktree), text inspection of .uproject/Config/Content (text parts only).
text_verification: Schema validation, JSON/YAML linting, custom project-owned text validators (when they exist under factory roots).
unreal_command_classification.compile: No discovered safe command-line compile wrapper. Building requires human (open .uproject or run VS build for Development Editor target of Gloamstead module).
unreal_command_classification.editor_generation: Whitelisted: agent_collab/scripts/Invoke-GloamsteadDataAssetImport.ps1 with -Manifest under specs/data/. Underlying UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=GloamsteadImportDataAssets only via that wrapper.
unreal_command_classification.map_load: No discovered command-line map validator. Requires human Editor/PIE load with evidence capture.
unreal_command_classification.automation_test: No discovered automation test runner or test code. Requires human.
unreal_command_classification.functional_test: No discovered functional test infrastructure. Requires human.
unreal_command_classification.package_smoke: No discovered cook or package scripts. Requires human.
unreal_command_classification.integration_verification: Combination of applicable profiles above + Critic audit of diff and binary file list. UE-dependent steps currently require human.
requires_human_approval: Any command that would install plugins, change EngineAssociation, download/purchase assets, accept licenses.

UnrealEditor-Cmd, RunUAT, BuildCookRun, or any cooking/packaging/automation command (even if the binary exists on the local machine) until explicitly whitelisted for a specific task with assigned generated_output_ownership.
forbidden: Commands that write to Intermediate/, Saved/, DerivedDataCache/, Binaries/ from within scripts.
Direct modification of .uasset/.umap etc. outside of approved automation on an owned task branch.

enforcement_notes: Shell policy is defense-in-depth only. Authoritative controls are: runtime capability validation in registry, exclusive Orchestrator lease, explicit handoff file_ownership + generated_output_ownership, edit-scope guards, worktree isolation, vendor immutability, structured result validation, Critic binary audits, and candidate integration verification.

whitelisted_commands.reason: Approved Data Asset factory wrapper (VS-POLISH-FACTORY-DATA-01). Must use -Manifest under specs/data/.
